en: So it's finally come...{wait}{clear}I'll go, for everyone's sake. And for my brother, who tried to protect our country... And besides...{wait}{clear}I don't know what's going to happen, but I'll beat the Heavenly Dragon, I promise. And then I want to start walking my own path.
All right, I'll go. If a monster's turned up in Legrance, I can't leave it alone.
All right, I'll go right away. That road matters for our ties with the Six Kingdoms Alliance too. It'd be bad if the damage got any worse.
I can't ignore something happening in Legrance. I'll go.
All right, I'll go right away! Private soldiers of the eastern nobles... They're probably planning something outrageous...{wait}{clear}I have to go stop them...
＄＄＄＄＄＄, I'll go right away. If that highway becomes unusable, it'll be a disaster!
All right, ＄＄＄＄＄＄, I'll go.{wait}{clear}It's happening in Legrance. If I don't go, who will?
Hobgoblins, you say? All right, I'll go right away.
A sea dragon at Salem? That village won't be able to do a thing about it...{wait}{clear}I'll go right away.
The coast at Ripa is a really beautiful place... And yet something like that...{wait}{clear}All right, I'll go and find out what's causing it.
A crooked moneylender, you say? All right, I'll go.{wait}{clear}If people like that are running wild, it's partly my responsibility...
Monsters showed up in a place like that? All right, I'll go right away. If I don't, things'll get bad.
Monsters and soldiers in Cadiz? ...All right...{wait}{clear}I can tell myself it's because of times like these, right...? Damn it...! I'll do something about it...
All right... I'll go... The Empire's a nasty place, but the people living there have nothing to do with it...
All right... I'll take down anyone like that, no matter what. I won't let them anywhere near Fanlan!
The Empire's come all the way to the Holy City? All right... Let me go...
It's really him, isn't it? All right, let me go. This time I'll pay back what I owe him.
Just like the legend... Damn it, how ridiculous!{wait}{clear}But I'm responsible too... Let's go...
Viper, huh... I owe that guy more than I can ever repay...{wait}{clear}This time, I'll settle things.
I see... All right... I'll go.{wait}{clear}I don't know what I can do once I'm there, but I'll do everything I can.
Ravenruft Castle, huh...{wait}{clear}All right... I'll go.

I never dreamed it would come to this...{wait}{clear}Maybe this is the first and last trial for someone who's been coasting on everything, like me.{wait}{clear}My mind's already made up. I go, and I defeat the Heavenly Dragon. That's all.{wait}{clear}I can't keep running away forever. But it'll be fine, I'm sure. Wait for me.
The Empire in Ecclesia? And attacking a small village, no less...{wait}{clear}...＄＄＄＄＄＄, I'll go...{n}
All right... I'll go. I can't forgive vermin that low.
A sea dragon at Rajes? All right, I'll go.
A crooked moneylender, huh... There's always one of those everywhere, isn't there...{wait}{clear}I'll go.
All right... If I'll do, I'll go...
All right, I'll go right away. I don't want to lose any more than I already have...
Only women are going missing? All right, I'll go and look into the cause.
All the way out there? Hmm...{wait}{clear}All right, I'll go. It's a pain, but a promise is a promise.
All right, I'll go. Something about the Empire bothers me...
The Empire at the Guild?{wait}{clear}I have to go! The Master and the others are in danger, aren't they?!
The Holy City too... No way...{wait}{clear}＄＄＄＄＄＄, let me go. I may not be able to do anything, but it's better than not going.
The Demon Stone? All right... That interests me...{wait}{clear}Let me go, ＄＄＄＄＄＄.
Right... I have to go... I'm the one who has to go...{wait}{clear}I'll go right away, or something terrible will happen!
So that's what happened... All right, I'll go.{wait}{clear}I'll do everything I can, but however painful the outcome, hang in there...

I have to go, don't I...{wait}{clear}I was always alone... I never once thought about this world, but I've realized...{wait}{clear}This world matters to me. I can't let something like the Heavenly Dragon destroy it.{wait}{clear}So I'll go. Whatever happens, I'm not afraid. I'll defeat the Heavenly Dragon, I promise.
Creatures that aren't human? That really makes me curious...{wait}{clear}＄＄＄＄＄＄, let me go.
All right, I'll go! If ships can't get through, the people of Bremes will be in real trouble!
A sea dragon at Bremes? All right, I'll go right away.
Something that awful in Bremes? All right, I'll go right away.
All right. If I'll do, I'll go...
Summoning monsters? That's outrageous! I'll go and stop it!
What?! The imperial army is invading Larissa...?{wait}{clear}...All right. I'll go and see with my own eyes... what on earth is happening...
All right. I'll head for Lamia right away. This is something I have to deal with... me...
Jena, in Lanas... They're pushing deeper and deeper toward the heart of the Six Kingdoms...{wait}{clear}All right, I'll go right away.
General Kaiser, you say?!{wait}{clear}All right... I'll go...
Alberic?! For that man to come out himself...{wait}{clear}And if he's after the Guild, something's going on. ＄＄＄＄＄＄, I'll go right away.
So the march on the Holy City has finally begun... ＄＄＄＄＄＄, let me go...
The Demon Stone... All right, I'll go right away and take it back.
The legend... Those people must have been using the Empire all along...{wait}{clear}＄＄＄＄＄＄, let me go. I'll see what's happening in the Empire with my own eyes.
Alberic... All right...{wait}{clear}I'll settle this... I'll make this my last battle with that man. For my parents' sake, too...{wait}{clear}Watch me, ＄＄＄＄＄＄.
All right... I'll go...{wait}{clear}I understand how you feel, but be ready for anything that might happen...

＄＄＄＄＄＄, only now do I feel I can calmly think about everything...{wait}{clear}All the things that have happened were trials for me... for the me who knew nothing...{wait}{clear}I want to take another look at myself and start walking anew.{wait}{clear}For that, and for everyone who's suffering, I'll defeat the Heavenly Dragon, no matter what.{wait}{clear}It'll be all right... You were here with me, so I'm sure it'll go well.
Creatures that aren't human? ...I'll go and find out what's happening.
Jotun in Erlanges is a very small village...{wait}{clear}I'll go and help.
Something that terrible is happening? All right... If I'll do, I'll go.
Lots of people use the Seriphos highway. And monsters there... I'll go, ＄＄＄＄＄＄.
All right... Monsters kill people indiscriminately... I won't... let that happen...
All right... I'll go... No, I have to go, because it's me...
The Titans? But... they made a pact with the elders not to attack the village...{wait}{clear}I understand. I'll head for Dilolo, and try talking with them.
A magical beast...? Something about it... really bothers me...{wait}{clear}I understand. I'll head there right away.
The imperial army at Ragwort?! Why the forest...?{wait}{clear}I understand. I'll head there right away, Angel!

The Zarha area? The forest around there is called the Forest of Shadows, and they say spirits live there.{wait}{clear}The villagers fear the spirits, so hardly any of them should go near it...{wait}{clear}Angel, it's a problem of the forest, so I'll go.
I understand, Angel.{wait}{clear}If anything happened to the Holy Mother in Rooak, it could never be undone. I'll head there right away.
The imperial army is marching on the Holy City...?{wait}{clear}Angel, please let me go. I may not be able to do anything... but I can't just stand by and watch.
The Demon Stone?! I understand, I'll head there right away!
I understand. I can't let that boy pile up any more sins.{wait}{clear}I'll head for Fano right away.
Angel... I'm not giving up yet. Surely, surely there's something I can do.{wait}{clear}I'm going, to the Tower of Kaluga!
Angel... So the thing I didn't want to think about has happened...{wait}{clear}I'll go... for his sake, too...
I understand... I'll go...
